name: PKC
label: Protein Kinase C activity
description: Integrated phosphorylation readout capturing activity across multiple PKC isoforms.
mechanism: Activated downstream of PLCγ-mediated DAG and calcium signaling. PKC propagates intracellular signaling and modulates MAPK pathway activity.

name: PKA
label: Protein Kinase A substrate activity
description: Aggregate motif-based phosphorylation signal reflecting cyclic AMP dependent kinase activity.
mechanism: Acts through cAMP-mediated phosphorylation cascades largely parallel to MAPK signaling.

name: Raf
label: Raf phosphorylation
description: Upstream MAPK regulator controlling MEK phosphorylation dynamics.
mechanism: Receives upstream signaling from receptor and PKC-related pathways and activates MEK.

name: Mek
label: MEK phosphorylation
description: Central kinase mediating Raf-to-ERK information transfer.
mechanism: Activated directly by Raf and propagates downstream MAPK signaling toward ERK.

name: Erk
label: ERK phosphorylation
description: Terminal MAPK signaling output associated with proliferation and transcriptional activation.
mechanism: Activated downstream of MEK and integrates proliferative signaling responses.

name: Akt
label: Akt phosphorylation
description: Downstream PI3K/Akt pathway kinase involved in metabolism and survival signaling.
mechanism: Activated through membrane recruitment driven by PIP3 accumulation.

name: Jnk
label: JNK phosphorylation
description: Stress-activated MAPK pathway component responding to perturbation.
mechanism: Activated by environmental stress and inflammatory signaling.

name: P38
label: p38 phosphorylation
description: MAPK stress-response signaling component associated with inflammatory pathways.
mechanism: Activated under stress and inflammatory signaling conditions.

name: Plcg
label: PLCγ phosphorylation
description: Phospholipase signaling regulator controlling phosphoinositide hydrolysis.
mechanism: Consumes PIP2 to generate second messengers driving PKC activation.

name: PIP3
label: Phosphatidylinositol (3,4,5)-trisphosphate
description: Membrane phospholipid generated by PI3K activity.
mechanism: Acts as a membrane docking signal for Akt recruitment and activation.

name: PIP2
label: Phosphatidylinositol (4,5)-bisphosphate
description: Membrane phospholipid precursor consumed by PLCγ and PI3K signaling pathways.
mechanism: Serves as upstream substrate for both PIP3 generation and PLCγ-mediated second messenger signaling.
